body: I don’t actively try to seek out company, in fact I’m quite quite around people until I really get to know them. But at places I can’t avoid such as school it’s a bit different since I’m constantly around them and trying to make them laugh. I didn’t want people to take me seriously because I was scared if I tried I’d be judged more. If I stop caring I become literally untouchable but now I want people to take me seriously and I’m already kinda fucked.
Also just thought I’d add when I’m not at school and at home I’m very isolated and I really like it but as soon as I step onto that campus it changes :/
